newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds, futures under early pressure, seen subdued.
newsitem.headline: Bunds, futures under early pressure, seen subdued.

text.p: German Bunds and futures came under early pressure on Thursday after first-quarter GDP data showed the economy growing faster than analysts had expected.

DTB June futures opened in negative ground and slipped further as the Federal Statistics Office said the economy grew at 0.5 percent quarter-on-quarter in the first three months of the year and at 1.4 percent year-on-year.
By 0635 GMT, the June contract was nine basis points lower at 101.36, while the September future was down 10 at 100.30.
The September contract was showing slightly higher trading volumes, although neither contract was heavily traded.
